Check POWER data for any missing values

Source: R/get_wth.R
dot-check_na.Rd

Check POWER data for any missing values

Usage

.check_na(.wth)

Arguments

.wth

A data.frame object from nasapower::get_power with weather data for checking Checks the data returned from the POWER dataset and informs the user if missing values are found. It does not do anything other than emitting a message about missing data.

Value

Called for its side-effects, an invisible NULL.

Examples

wth <- setDT(
  nasapower::get_power(
    lonlat = c(121.25562, 14.6774),
    dates = "2000-06-30",
    community = "AG",
    pars = c(
      "T2M",
      "T2M_MIN",
      "T2M_MAX",
      "RH2M",
      "PRECTOTCORR"
    ),
    temporal_api = "DAILY"
  )
)

wth[, c("YEAR", "MM", "DD") := NULL][]
#>         LON     LAT   DOY   YYYYMMDD   T2M T2M_MIN T2M_MAX  RH2M PRECTOTCORR
#>       <num>   <num> <int>     <Date> <num>   <num>   <num> <num>       <num>
#> 1: 121.2556 14.6774   182 2000-06-30 26.02   23.34   28.76 88.53       11.01
setnames(
  wth,
  old = c(
    "T2M",
    "T2M_MIN",
    "T2M_MAX",
    "PRECTOTCORR",
    "RH2M"
  ),
  new = c(
    "TEMP",
    "TMIN",
    "TMAX",
    "RAIN",
    "RHUM"
  )
)
.check_na(wth)
